<b>Longpin</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it throws a heavy pin forwards in an arc.

== Usefulness ==
The Longpin can be used to damage [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] through shields and heavy plating that block [[Needle]] attacks, such as the skull of the [[Skull Tyrant]]. It can be useful to hit enemies who can parry Needle attacks and to hit foes through their defences.

The arcing throw of the Longpin can be useful to hit airborne enemies.

== How to Acquire ==
Located in [[Shellwood]], above the connecting entrance to [[Bellhart]]. It can be found in a bell hidden behind a [[Wood Wasp]] nest, besides the corpse of a dead [[Pondcatcher]].

== Trivia ==
* [[Phantom]] is exceptionally skilled with a longpin.<ref>[[Phantom]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Mournful creature tasked alone to expel the Citadel's choking refuse. Their talent with a longpin is unmatched."</i></ref>
* [[Pondcatcher]]s use similar longpins to attack.<ref>[[Pondcatcher]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Old catcher over Shellwood Pond, bearing a longpin and stricken by the Haunting."</i></ref>
